bio.text: Ben Cline has represented Virginia's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House since his election in 2018.
He served in the Virginia House of Delegates from 2002 to 2018 and, from 2007 to 2013, as an Assistant Commonwealth's Attorney for Rockingham County and the City of Harrisonburg.
Cline grew up in Rockbridge County, holds a B.A. from Bates College and a law degree from the University of Richmond, and lives in Botetourt County.
